fair_value_reason: Horizon (Oct-2027) value on NTM ~ CY2028, with 125M diluted shares and $1.1B horizon net debt (finance leases in, operating leases out). P/E: 36x (infrastructure median 23.7x plus a modest growth premium, below 'PEG parity' because ORCL, CRWV and AKAM show contracted capital-intensive growth is not paid a premium) x CY28 EPS $2.40 = $86. EV/EBITDA: 15x (13.7x consensus-basis infrastructure median + ~10%) x NTM adj. EBITDA $0.95B = $14.25B, less $1.1B, = $105. EV/sales: 5.5x (5.1x infrastructure median + ~8%) x $2.45B = $13.5B, less $1.1B, = $99. Equal weights give ~$97, which I round to $98. That is down from my round-1 $112, because I re-derived the medians on one consensus basis instead of reusing my round-1 multiples (16x / 6.5x / 40x). The forecasters' round-2 mean is $103 (range $94-108); agents 4 and 5 are high mainly because of the comps issues noted in revision_check.

thesis_triggers.event: $78 is ~43x the ~$1.80 CY27 street EPS, just above the $77 March 2026 offering price, and ~14x CY27 consensus EBITDA ($730M) on the ~$0.28B current net debt. That is the infrastructure-peer EV/EBITDA median (13.7x) with no growth premium and ~20% below my $98 fair value. Ordinary 80% volatility can visit it, but a sustained level there would mean the >50% 2027 growth commitment, the $894M RPO (3.7-year weighted life) or the nine-figure AI contracts had broken, or that lease-funded capex forced another dilutive raise. Agents ranged $75-85, mean $78.8.

supervisor_summary: Round 2 converged on verified facts (125M shares, ~$0.28B net debt, $1.80 CY27 EPS, $1.81B CY27 revenue), and fair values tightened to $94-108. But most of the multiple convergence (16x EV/EBITDA, 36-40x P/E, 6.5x EV/sales) is anchoring on my round-1 file; only agents 1 and 3 rebuilt comps independently. Re-deriving the peers on one consensus basis gives infrastructure medians of 23.7x P/E, 13.7x EV/EBITDA and 5.1x EV/sales. The cross-section (ORCL 14.5x, CRWV 7.5x EV/EBITDA, AKAM 16x even after a 7-year $11.6B Anthropic deal) does not support PEG-parity premiums, so my reconciled fair value is ~$98, versus $140 spot and ~78x CY27 EPS. I keep the forecasters' mean ladder (median ~$129, P(>=140)=0.44) with low confidence, because valuation gaps are weak 12-month predictors at 80% volatility, and the Q3 print (~Nov 2-5) falls just after the 1-month window.
key_drivers: Delivery on >50% 2027 revenue growth (consensus $1.81B), backed by the $894M RPO ($366M within 12 months, 3.7-year weighted life) and capacity coming online through 2027; the Q3 print (~Nov 2-5) is the first test.

Multiple regime: DOCN is at ~78x CY27 street EPS and ~22.9x CY27 EV/EBITDA, versus 23.7x and 13.7x infrastructure-peer medians. Capital-intensive AI growers (ORCL 14.5x, CRWV 7.5x EV/EBITDA, AKAM 16x even after an $11.6B Anthropic deal) are not being paid a persistent premium.
EPS conversion: gross margin 59.9% -> 55.0%, H1 D&A +56%, $2.76B of uncommenced operating leases commencing Jul-2026 to Jun-2028, and FY26 consensus ($1.46) above the $1.35-1.40 guide.
Funding: ~$0.28B net debt today rising to ~$1.0-1.1B with MUFG finance-lease draws, $312M of 2026 notes due 12/1/26, and two 2026 equity raises.
GPU-rental pricing and neocloud sentiment: the H100 neo-cloud index is firm ($2.78/hr), compute futures start 10/5, and the Aug-Sep 2026 neocloud de-rating produced DOCN's 41% drawdown.
